description: This Java class 'SendConf' represents a Send Confirmation PDU message used in MMS (Multimedia Messaging Service) to confirm message delivery status. The class provides methods to set and get message headers like Message-ID, Response Status, and Transaction ID, and is instantiated by a parser or constructed with headers.

classes.name: SendConf
classes.description: A class representing a Send Confirmation (Delivery receipt acknowledgment) MMS PDU, allowing setting and retrieval of message identifiers and response statuses.

methods.name: SendConf
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the SendConf object, potentially throwing InvalidHeaderValueException.

methods.name: SendConf
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the SendConf object with provided headers.

methods.name: getMessageId
methods.description: Returns the Message ID byte array.

methods.name: setMessageId
methods.description: Sets the Message ID header value with a byte array.

methods.name: getResponseStatus
methods.description: Returns the response status as an integer.

methods.name: setResponseStatus
methods.description: Sets the response status header, may throw InvalidHeaderValueException.

methods.name: getTransactionId
methods.description: Returns the Transaction ID byte array.

methods.name: setTransactionId
methods.description: Sets the Transaction ID header value with a byte array.
